title: Enforce coherent STM32 CAN controller requirements
problem: STM32F103 PA11/PA12 were assigned to USB and CAN simultaneously and a 7-24V input was paired with a 6V-maximum MCP1700.
rootCause: Interface pin ownership and regulator absolute-maximum constraints were not template invariants.
solution: Use a 4.75-5.25V CAN-only STM32F103 template with exclusive PA11/PA12 CAN ownership, voltage margin, exact termination/TVS/decoupling BOM, and strict gates.
limitations: Live stock must refresh at execution time.
EMC and surge compliance require product review.
